claim: A limit of 100 concurrent copy jobs from one Region to another applies per account per Region, and it applies only to resource types fully managed by AWS Backup. The quota is not adjustable.
question: How many concurrent cross-Region or in-Region copy jobs can one account run in a destination Region?

qualifiers.scope: per account, per destination Region; resource types fully managed by AWS Backup only
qualifiers.condition: resource types fully managed by AWS Backup

evidence.quote: 1The limit for concurrent copy jobs from one Region to another Region is 100 per account per Region. Once this limit is reached, if a specific vault in the destination Region has fewer than 5 concurrent copy jobs, new copy jobs can begin, up to a maximum of 5 concurrently.
| Concurrent cross-Region or in-Region copy jobs per account in destination Region | 1002 | No |
2Limit only apply to resource types [fully managed by AWS Backup](backup-feature-availability.md).
